title: world.index.get
description: The client asks for a region's WorldIndex it doesn't hold (after a world.index.offer), by the content hash the offer named. The server answers with the index's world.index parts (deflated) while it still publishes it, else with nothing (a rebuild sends a new offer).

hash.description: The index wanted: the offer's hash.

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
